$comment: Google Cloud icons (https://cloud.google.com/icons): <product>/SVG/<ProductName>-512-color[-rgb].svg, or <product_name>.svg in the newer sets. The size and colour suffixes go, CamelCase is split and the rest kebab-cased: ComputeEngine-512-color-rgb.svg -> compute-engine, cloud_run.svg -> cloud-run. Each product has a folder of its own, so the folders give no categories. No Mermaid Chart sample with gcp: names was available (design Q-1): overrides map a file name (without .svg) to the icon name where Mermaid Chart's differs.
